title: How much did India's population grow in 50 years?
description: A bar graph shows the population of India in each decade over fifty years, in crores, with one unit of length for ten crores. Subtracting bar values gives the growth over fifty years and in each decade, and Keeko's doubt, that the last bar is the growth, is checked against what the bars show.
teaching_notes: One idea: a bar shows a total at one time, so growth comes from subtracting one bar from another. Watch for students who read the tallest bar as the increase.

source: This bar graph shows the population of India in each decade over a period of 50 years. The numbers are expressed in crores. How much did the population of India increase over 50 years? How much did the population increase in each decade?
video_script.why: The child learns that a bar shows a total at one time, and that growth is the difference between two bars.
video_script.substitution: Subtract the earlier bar from the later bar, over fifty years and then decade by decade.
video_script.anchor: the bar graph of the population of India in crores, one bar for each decade from 1951 to 2001, with one unit of length for ten crores
video_script.wrong_answer: the population increased by one hundred and two crores, because the last bar is the highest
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko reads the height of the last bar as the increase. The bar is the whole population in that year, so the first bar must be taken away.
video_script.payoff_line: The population grew by sixty six crores in fifty years

final_answer.value: Over 50 years: 102 - 36 = 66 crores. Per decade: 8, 10, 14, 16 and 18 crores
final_answer.spoken: the population grew by sixty six crores in fifty years, and by eight, ten, fourteen, sixteen and eighteen crores in the five decades

maths_rules: scale: 1 unit length = 10 crores; a bar of 5 units is 50 crores and a bar of 8 units is 80 crores
video_script.design: One idea: growth is a difference of two bars. The bar graph stays on the board all video and two bars are marked in turn.

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is an example from your book about the people of India.
<bookmark mark='graph'/>The bar graph shows the population in each decade over fifty years, in crores.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>How much did the population grow over fifty years, and how much in each decade?

beats.on_screen: the bar graph stays on the board and Keeko sits at the corner of the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: a small bar of 5 units labelled 50 crores and a bar of 8 units labelled 80 crores; a label reads 1 unit of length = 10 crores

marks.label: a label reads 1 unit of length = 10 crores
marks.five: a bar of 5 units appears and is labelled 50 crores
marks.eight: a bar of 8 units appears and is labelled 80 crores

narration: <bookmark mark='label'/>Giving each person one unit would make the bars far too long. The graph uses one unit of length for ten crores.
<bookmark mark='five'/>A bar of five units shows fifty crores.
<bookmark mark='eight'/>A bar of eight units shows eighty crores.

marks.early: the first three bars are written with their values 36, 44, 54
marks.late: the last three bars are written with their values 68, 84, 102

narration: <bookmark mark='early'/>Given, the bars read thirty six, forty four and fifty four crores.
<bookmark mark='late'/>The next three read sixty eight, eighty four and one hundred and two crores.

beats.on_screen: To find: the growth over 50 years, and the growth in each decade

marks.find: the words the growth over 50 years and in each decade are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the growth over fifty years and the growth in each decade.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: a bar shows the population in one year, so growth is the difference of two bars; the first bar 36 and the last bar 102 are marked

marks.bar: the words a bar shows the population in one year are written
marks.pair: the first bar 36 and the last bar 102 are marked

narration: <bookmark mark='bar'/>Step one, remember that each bar shows the whole population in one year.
<bookmark mark='pair'/>Growth is the gap between two bars. For fifty years, we compare the first bar and the last bar.

marks.gap: 102 - 36 = 66 is written as the gap between the first and the last bar

narration: <bookmark mark='take'/>Step two, take the first bar away from the last bar.
<bookmark mark='gap'/>One hundred and two take away thirty six leaves sixty six crores.

marks.first: 44 - 36 = 8 and 54 - 44 = 10 are written between the first bars

narration: <bookmark mark='first'/>Step three, take each bar away from the next bar. Forty four take away thirty six is eight, and fifty four take away forty four is ten.
<bookmark mark='next'/>Sixty eight take away fifty four is fourteen.
<bookmark mark='last'/>Eighty four take away sixty eight is sixteen. One hundred and two take away eighty four is eighteen.

beats.on_screen: Answer: the population grew by 66 crores in 50 years; in the decades it grew by 8, 10, 14, 16 and 18 crores

marks.pay: the first part of the answer is boxed
marks.decades: the five decade growths are boxed in a row

narration: <bookmark mark='pay'/>The population grew by sixty six crores in fifty years.
<bookmark mark='decades'/>In the five decades it grew by eight, ten, fourteen, sixteen and eighteen crores.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the bar graph
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble says the population increased by 102 crores because the last bar is the highest; the first bar 36 is shaded inside the last bar 102; the bubble is struck through

marks.inside: the first bar of 36 crores is shaded inside the last bar of 102 crores

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the population increased by one hundred and two crores, because the last bar is the highest.
<bookmark mark='inside'/>But that bar shows the whole population in the last year. Thirty six crores of it were already there at the start.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Only the part above the first bar is new, so we take the first bar away.
